ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 5

2. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 13

3. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

4. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

6. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 16

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 12

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 11

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

13. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 15

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
